# Methodology and revision record

Review edition dated 25 October 2026. This record supplements, rather than replaces, the repository's historical methodology and provenance disclosures.

## Origin and roles

The selected manuscripts originate in the existing Elenchus repository: Claude A5 v1, Claude A6 v1 and E3 v3. The causation reserve originates in Claude A4 v1. This pass was performed by an OpenAI Codex assistant and substantively revised all four. No additional agents or independent model reviewers were launched in this pass. Its adversarial evaluations are self-review, not a new Claude, Gemini, Opus, philosopher or future-model verdict.

The earlier repository reports identify the Claude authoring environment and distinguish drafting and synthetic referee roles. Those reports are historical evidence, not a complete verified platform transcript. This edition does not infer an exact historical model version from prose and does not certify one where the record is incomplete.

## Inputs and human participation

The user requested completion for review, had previously authorized publication to GitHub, and asked for rigorous originality checks, stronger arguments, and philosophy beyond merely pleasing the judging panel. The user said philosophical feedback was being withheld for the contest. This pass used the repository drafts, existing review comments and source records, and retrieved literature. It did not solicit a new philosophical thesis or argument from the user.

Personal context was not searched for ideas. Automatically available context does not by itself establish a contribution, and this report does not certify the absence of all historical influence. No unrelated personal material is included in the manuscripts. The repository's PROVENANCE-CLARIFICATION.md and earlier concern disclosures remain part of the record; no standing rule or earlier disclosure was removed by this revision.

The starting branch snapshot was 4fb0507a21f31aceaa10a16f0442d27d5f3389c2. Original drafts remain available at their original paths. The new files are an explicitly versioned external review edition.

## Manuscript-specific work

### A5: Holistic Accuracy

Rechecked the core argument against Dorst's published pp. 192–195 and 206–207, read the relevant full-text Wang comparison, and reran the exact counterexample, robustness and structural checks. Distinguished a pair of sufficient separability-restoring assumptions from a claim that separability is necessary for every Lockean result. Made the reading of Sequence-Irrelevance and the permission premise explicit. Removed the secondary split-invariance result, including its overstrong minimality claim. Corrected consistency, threshold ties, and checking counts. Added a representation-dependence objection. The broad theory of rational belief remains unsettled; the manuscript argues for a specific obstruction to a derivation.

### A6: Free Evidence

Reread the finite proofs, reran the comparable finite cases and numerical measurement example, and verified a counterexample to the original zero-value assertion. Corrected the distinction between a given safe question and safety for all available questions. Added an explicit positive-measure Gaussian argument instead of transferring a singleton finite proof to a continuous space. Stated the conditional probability assumption. Narrowed the moderate-stakes and encroachment claims. Read Hong's previously unavailable discussion and revised the novelty comparison. The results concern the specified decision rules and model classes, not all practical roles of knowledge.

### E3: Flattening

Checked the target's discussion using the repository source extract and reran the explicit cases, controls, finite conservativity and crashing-fragment checks. The optional historical Z3 checks were not rerun because that dependency was absent. Revised the thesis, abstract, locality discussion, context-shift reply and conclusion to distinguish mathematical representation from linguistic evidence. No participant study or new human judgment was collected. A contextual reply remains live.

### A4: causation reserve

Repaired the frozen-witness lemma using AC3 minimality and acyclic uniqueness, removing an invalid inference about parents of members of a conjunctive cause. Restricted the coding result to the four stated default codings and the ranking result to its local uniform class. Replaced claims of indisputable causal judgments with a conditional argument. Reran the existing case program. The book-level comparison and general adequacy of the chosen representations remain incomplete.

## Evaluation, selection and records

Selection prioritizes an explicit alleged increment and a serious possible objection. A5 and A6 have the clearest checkable results in this pass; E3 is a provisional third because the interpretation dispute remains substantial. The wider archive has 13 developed tracks covering approximately 10 arguments and eight shorter exploratory drafts. That is an inventory, not a count of discoveries. The earlier 120-idea register and its filters remain in the repository and were not expanded in this closing pass.

The review guide distinguishes new assessment from inherited reserve-track dispositions. It does not convert earlier negative reviews into acceptances or claim that responding to a criticism is the same as passing review. The supplied revision differences make the changes inspectable. VALIDATION.md records which computations were rerun and which were not.

## Tools, time, cost and eligibility

Tools supported retrieval, text editing, exact arithmetic and numerical checks, word counts, basic manuscript scans, PDF typesetting, visual inspection and publication of the review edition. They did not generate an independent referee endorsement. No paid external model pipeline was invoked in this pass.

Exact cumulative model time, human time, token usage and actual cost across the project were not established. Budget caps and subscription resets are not reported as measured expenditure. This document records work completed in the current revision, not an invented continuous background run.

The manuscripts are anonymous review copies. This methodology record intentionally distinguishes authorship disclosure from the essay text. It is not an eligibility attestation, an exhaustive transcript audit or a final submission form. No contest submission was made. Preserve the original chats and historical repository logs if a later submission requires a fuller production record.
